prior_evidence.scope: 1,226,945 common fitting rows only; no scoring/stopping/December/ranking labels. AOBT is generally better than LOBT, while the source clocks have substantial disagreement. Missing-clock offsets retain some large positive and negative residuals. The original ladder batch has seven of eight fits complete; no scaled-target development model has been fitted.

configuration.refit_iterations: Each active new model uses the ties-to-even rounded median of its two October-selected tree counts. Imported v6 components retain all original counts.
configuration.routing: Unchanged present/missing NM-clock covariate routes. Present-clock family predictions combine 50% new global with 50% frozen v6 airport models. Missing experts retain the unchanged conditional LIRF schedule offset. No filtering or clipping.
configuration.selection: Complete all eight new LightGBM fits and all twenty fixed candidate recipes. The incumbent is the selected first-ladder recipe if eligible, otherwise v6; the first-ladder selection must be complete and verified before these fits. Require 0.5% lower complete RMSE on EACH fold than that incumbent, then select lowest equally weighted mean ratio. All blends remain explicitly anchored on the frozen v6 components. Otherwise retain the incumbent.
configuration.target_formulation: z=(target-offset)/scale; sample_weight=(scale/300)^2; prediction=offset+scale*z_hat. The weighted data loss is exactly squared error in seconds divided by 300^2. Regularization acts on the transformed model. October stopping is measured explicitly in physical seconds on every routed row.
